api-tools.description: REST API development utilities and middleware

files.README.md:
# api-tools

Utilities for building and testing REST APIs.

- Request validator
- Response formatter
- Schema generator
files.Makefile:
build:
	go build -o api-tools .

test:
	go test ./...

# form-builder

Create forms from JSON schema definitions.

```json
{"type": "form", "fields": [{"name": "email", "type": "email"}]}
```
